# Closed carrier substitutions of parent formals

This independently owned fixture forwards an incoming `List<Payload>` to an
Object-erased parent class formal substituted by that same complete type. A
fixed `Collection<Payload>`, callback and opaque token retain their independent
contracts; the child forwards a subset of eight incoming parameters.

Frozen observers run forty fresh JVM cases twice, including null and aliased
carriers, unchecked heterogeneous contents, callbacks during parent construction,
virtual reads of child defaults, late writes, partial initialization, scalar
ordering and exact exceptions. Twenty wrong programs fail before recovery. Source
and dependency profiles compile all emitted Java8 units and preserve complete
definitions, metadata, roles and Exceptions. Eight Signature-only controls retain
original Code and runtime descriptors.
